verdict.rationale: Missive ships an in-product AI Assistant/Copilot. It runs long sessions with visible progress, creates drafts, composes, replies and translates messages, and can pull in internal data via MCP tools (docs-16/27/42, 34, 45, 49). However, it runs only on the user's own Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini API key (intdir-2), and the inbox summarization and CRM triage examples (docs-21/22) describe external agents connecting via MCP, not in-app insights. missing for 10: explicit documentation of in-product AI insights or summaries over the user's conversation data, built-in AI without a BYO key, independent or hands-on corroboration.
